|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Arica (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-arica-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-arica022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/arica.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/arica.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Arica”. Text: “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Arica (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 11 January 2021<ref name="img-aricadc382c8">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/arica.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/dc382c854e17cf7cc3c15a9cbf70237855c820f0 commit dc382c8] (11 January 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/arica.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force.
